title: A short step sequence works best when every step names one action the learner can observe.
summary: The rail keeps the sequence readable while the active step gives an adult a clear place to pause, point, and coach.
footer: Move to the next step only after the visible action is complete.

callout.label: Coach prompt
callout.value: Point to the step, then wait for the smallest successful move.

steps.headline: Three moves for a short practice start

items.title: Set one clear target
items.detail: Show the single word, problem, or movement the learner will work on first.

items.title: Try it once together
items.detail: Model the action briefly, then let the learner repeat the same move with support.

items.title: Name what changed
items.detail: Close by noticing the concrete evidence that the learner completed the target.
